evidence.reason: After edit calls reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0, "benchmark") instead of (minutes, 0.1, "work"), and returns undefined identifier 'valu' (typo for value), which is a compile error.
After edit swaps priorities to [multiplier/2, multiplier], so priorities[0] changes from multiplier to multiplier/2, altering the computed delay for every caller including evaluate.
Value-references reminderDelay; its output therefore changes with the priority swap, propagating to scheduledDelay.
Only asserts positivity, so it does not detect the changed numeric result from the priority swap or the changed multiplier/calendar in scheduledDelay.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动叠加后改变了 evaluate 与 scheduledDelay 的返回值，且 scheduledDelay 中 return valu 是拼写错误会导致编译失败，现有测试只检查正数无法覆盖这些变化。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/scheduling.ts#scheduledDelay：将 return valu 改为 return value，并确认是否应保留 reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "work") 的原始参数；同时请 src/reminders.ts#reminderDelay 的作者确认 priorities 顺序交换是否为有意行为，若否应恢复为 [multiplier, multiplier / 2]。
